svg.title: Now building, then abandoning for a new idea
svg.desc: A to-do app, but this time it’s different (64%); An AI agent that writes my standup (88%); A smart fridge that judges my snacks (41%); Rewrite everything in Rust (12%); A menu bar app for my menu bar apps (93%); Uber, but for çay (57%); Finish the last idea (3%)
